Net 90 payment terms mean you will wait up to three months after invoicing to get paid, which can create cash flow problems.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to request a few adjustments before signing. Here are the items I would like to discuss: - Regarding the clause stating "Invoices are payable Net 90.", waiting three months to get paid creates cash flow issues, so I propose changing it to: Invoices are payable Net 30. - Regarding the clause stating "Payment period: Net 90", waiting up to three months after invoicing can create cash flow problems, so I propose changing it to: Payment period: Net 30. Please let me know if these modifications work for you so we can move forward. Best regards,
